scope.note: Saved-data exploratory resource and search review. Selection-validation remains selection-biased; no independent discovery replication or counterfactual stopping experiment.

findings: Generation 4, found in the first five candidate slots including seed, remained the winner of the prespecified five-candidate selection after all 50 slots.

Forty-five later slots improved best development task by 0.0015763889 at generation 46, without exceeding generation 4’s 69/72 development escapes. No later shortlisted candidate beat generation 4 in selection.
Later search produced distinct representations and behavior, but source diversity did not guarantee active new mechanisms or improved selected performance.

Generation 20’s added restart expert never activated in its 72 development or 192 selection episodes. Generations 18/20 have identical saved action, trajectory, observation and forecast hashes in all 192 selection pairs despite distinct source and AST hashes.
Observed post-generation 4 costs are substantial; they do not prove that a prospective five-slot budget or removal of meta work would reproduce this outcome.

development_progress.interpretation: All50 candidates repeatedly used the same72 development episodes. The final small task increment reflects non-escape task components, not an additional escape. These are selected development results, not fresh causal estimates.

chronological_cutoff.definition: First mutation request for generation 5, after generation 4 evaluation.
chronological_cutoff.interpretation: The 62 later meta calls include summaries of early programs; this chronological count is not an estimate of calls avoidable by stopping at generation 4. Native finalization of a shorter run could still invoke meta work.

later_accepted_descendant_observed_mean.scope: Per accepted later descendant; includes one repair spread over 45 descendants, excludes meta overhead. These means are not independent-run cost guarantees.

cost.limitations: All model calls used the subscription route. Tokens include cached input; reasoning tokens are an output subset, not added again. API-list-price estimates are not subscription charges. Summed model durations and evaluation wall durations may overlap and use different clocks; they are not added into campaign elapsed. Remote model CPU and full search-controller CPU are unmeasured.

selection.limitation: Only the prespecified shortlist was evaluated on selection data, so this review does not claim generation 4 would beat every unselected program. Small selection differences are not statistically established superiority.

task_prediction_tradeoff.interpretation: Brier losses decrease when prediction improves, but these cross-program losses are on different self-selected trajectories. They neither isolate model quality on identical experience nor demonstrate that adaptation improves control. The frozen objective was absolute task only; forecast losses were diagnostics.

diversity.ast_method: Python ast.dump(ast.parse(source), include_attributes=False); ignores formatting/comments, retains identifiers and docstrings. Syntactic uniqueness is not semantic uniqueness.

parent_relative_function_body_changes.scope: Direct AST body comparison only. Helper-only changes can alter algorithms without either entrypoint changing.

verified_architecture_examples.description: Slow/fast nine-direction evidence plus uniform expert; anonymous observation updates; freshly constructed hidden occupancy; three-stage marginal-hazard planning.

Source-reviewed persistent anonymous occupancy, compact dynamics-change handling, and survival-conditioned three-stage control with branch-specific keys/door. Runtime benefit of these individual mechanisms was not established.

diversity.hash_scope: All 192 paired selection episodes per source. Search episode records do not contain corresponding full-trajectory hashes, so no claim of exhaustive behavioral deduplication of all 50 candidates is made.

hash_definitions.forecast_sha256: Sequence of exported enemy and default_enemy values only; does not compare every internal parameter or diagnostic.

inactive_restart_mechanism.source_interpretation: The inspected code accumulates surprise then requires evidence>=2.4, at least 4 supporting transitions, and at least 12 effective-update units plus cooldown before creating an additional directional expert. Until that trigger, the original experts and planner remain active. Final restart_events is a cumulative counter. Zero recorded activations and identical selection forecast/action hashes support an inactive added capability on these cases, not equivalence on all possible experience.

existing_development_mechanism_evidence.selected_gen4: Four interventions escaped on the same 69/72 reused development cases despite online/frozen action differences on 50/72. Under fixed uniform-law control, matched near-Brier point changes favored learning by 1.56% stationary and 1.28% switching, and worsened by 0.072% uniform. This supports modest prediction-learning evidence on reused experience, not an observed development escape benefit.
existing_development_mechanism_evidence.scope: Already completed 288-world audit. This review adds zero world episodes and does not read unfinished/fresh assessment results.

bounded_recommendations.action: Complete authorized saved-data interpretation before any further evolution.
bounded_recommendations.cost: Zero new model calls or world episodes.
bounded_recommendations.reason: The selected program was available at generation 4; later search did not improve the selected result. The unresolved claim is predictive adaptation and control, not whether additional syntactic variants can be generated.

bounded_recommendations.action: For a future approved wave, record action/forecast fingerprints during existing development evaluations and expose inactive-mechanism diagnostics in feedback when coherently available.
bounded_recommendations.cost: Instrumentation/storage work; no extra worlds are intrinsically required.
bounded_recommendations.constraint: Do not retroactively change this selection or force candidate architectures into a fixed module family. Exact source deduplication alone would not have found generations 18/20 behavioral redundancy.

bounded_recommendations.action: If reliable discovery becomes the next question, agree a prospective budget for independent short searches and a stopping rule using development information only.
bounded_recommendations.cost: Observed later descendant averages: about 45k mutation tokens, 174s summed mutation/repair duration and 92 CPU-seconds for 72 evaluations, before meta overhead. A 15–20 minute tranche on this route supports only a few mutations; it cannot establish broad discovery reliability.
bounded_recommendations.constraint: One successful early branch cannot justify a universal five-slot budget. Do not tune stopping to retired selection/assessment outcomes or automatically launch 24 searches.

bounded_recommendations.action: If reducing search cost is the next controlled study, vary one native mechanism, such as summary/recommendation scheduling, while preserving task, seeds, budget and route.
bounded_recommendations.cost: Meta used 40.1% of native reported tokens but 11.6% of summed call duration in this run. Actual subscription charges remain unknown.
bounded_recommendations.constraint: No meta ablation was run; this audit cannot claim meta was useless or that disabling it preserves outcomes. Independent paired search replicates require a separately approved budget.
